Alex: Hey team — planning a canary rollout for the inference routing change (v3.2). Target window tomorrow 10:00-11:30 PT. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?

Maya: I can own the deploy. planning to do it from 10:05 PT.

Jordan: I'll be on standby for smoke checks and logs. What cohort are we using for the 5% canary?

Alex: Good — thanks Maya. Cohort = traffic from mobile-prod only (US-west users), then expand to 20% (all US) if green.

Lina: Suggest we run this ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds. If any error-rate spike > 1.5x baseline or latency p95 increases by >200ms, rollback immediately.

Maya: Sounds good. I'll do 5% at 10:05 PT (1745001500). No immediate errors in logs.

Jordan: Initial smoke pass: generation latencies steady, p95 +30ms, error rate baseline. All good so far.

Alex: Proceed to 20% in 10m if still green.

Maya: 20% at 10:26 PT (1745001960). Rolling update across routing layer.

Lina: Watching. If we see >1.5x errors will trigger rollback and notify SRE.

Jordan: 20% smoke: small tail latency bump +60ms p95 but error rate unchanged. Recommend continue to 50%.

Maya: Kicking 50% at 10:52 PT (1745002320).

deploy-bot: Canary 50% completed, cohort tags: mobile-prod (US-west), mobile-prod (US-east).

Jordan: At 50% p95 +180ms, error rate still within thresholds. I'm going to run a few randomized prompt sets to validate output quality.

Lina: Reminder: rollback plan = revert routing flag + redeploy previous routing config (v3.1), which takes ~3min to propagate. Maya, confirm you have the previous config ready as a quick rollback artifact.

Maya: Confirmed. I have v3.1 routing tag pinned and the rollback runbook open.

Alex: If 50% holds for 15m, final to 100% at ~11:10. Ops, are you OK with retention of extra logs for 2h?

ops-oncall: OK to keep verbose logs for 2h, then back to standard retention. I'll annotate the alert timeline.

Jordan: 50% hold ok. Running quality checks now — will post any issues.

Maya: 100% roll started at 11:09 PT (1745002940).

deploy-bot: Deployment completed at 1745003000. All routing nodes reporting healthy.

Alex: Great work everyone. Postmortem not needed if no regressions. Please drop a short post in #eng-releases with final metrics (p95, error-rate, token throughput). :tada: 

Jordan: Will post a snippet in ~30m.

Lina: Logged the rollout summary in the release doc, linking metrics and the runbook.

Maya: Closing this thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Jordan: For smoke tests I'll run:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
```
and check p95/err in Grafana panel "inference-routing-smoke".

ops-oncall: FYI I'll open a temporary alert silencing for planned spikes on canary metric "queue_latency" just during the window to avoid noisy alerts. Will not silence errors / 5xx alerts.
